scope: Cross-batch deduplication of all routed future learner concepts after Phase 3 source-pool reconciliation. Exact normalized accepted-name collapse only; final installer synonym/rank checks can reduce the count further.

projected_workload.interpretation: 633 is the corrected current working upper-bound distinct future-card workload after exact-name deduplication and queue-state reconciliation. Installer synonym/rank/identity checks may lower it further.

phase4_holds.name: Calylophus drummondii
phase4_holds.reason: Calylophus drummondii exact source spelling/authority is insufficient to choose among modern Oenothera mappings.

phase4_holds.name: Celtis ehrenbergiana
phase4_holds.reason: Current taxonomy can crosswalk the name, but legacy Texas usage conflicts with modern species concepts. Do not relabel old/local source material as C. iguanaea without specimen-level re-identification.

phase4_holds.name: Clematis reticulata
phase4_holds.reason: The scientific name is accepted, but current Kew native distribution is southeastern U.S. and excludes Texas; historical Texas records require re-identification under the modern C. reticulata-complex treatment.

phase4_holds.name: Grindelia squarrosa
phase4_holds.reason: Research queue preserves a taxonomy/concept HOLD: historical Central Texas nuda material must not be recycled into strict G. squarrosa; current authorities split/treat the nuda concept differently.

phase4_holds.name: Mimosa quadrivalvis
phase4_holds.reason: Mimosa quadrivalvis is an accepted species in Kew, but the historical/local source concept is likely a misapplied broader North American usage; specimen/source identity must be reconciled before learner admission.

phase4_holds.name: Onosmodium bejarense
phase4_holds.reason: Onosmodium bejarense is likely an orthographic error for O. bejariense, but exact source identity remains unverified.

phase4_holds.name: Parthenocissus inserta
phase4_holds.reason: POWO and FNA attach the name Parthenocissus inserta to conflicting concepts; morphology and nomenclature cannot be merged blindly.

phase4_holds.name: Philadelphus ernestii
phase4_holds.reason: Kew and ITIS disagree on Philadelphus ernestii versus P. texensis.

phase4_holds.name: Schoenocaulon drummondii
phase4_holds.reason: Two Schoenocaulon drummondii homonyms route to different accepted taxa; original authority is required.

phase4_holds.name: Silphium integrifolium
phase4_holds.reason: Research queue preserves a taxonomy/concept HOLD: historical Central Texas var. asperrimum material maps to current S. asperrimum under Kew and cannot prove strict S. integrifolium.

phase4_holds.name: Solanum ptycanthum
phase4_holds.reason: Historical Solanum ptycanthum/ptychanthum usage intersects the S. americanum/emulans complex; source identity remains ambiguous.

phase4_holds.name: Taraxacum officinale
phase4_holds.reason: Kew treats Taraxacum officinale at sectional-complex level rather than a single accepted replacement species.
